Thanks for the sample. I can handle special characters and Unicode just fine. Here are a few common encodings of your string:
Original: Text with special characters: <>&"' and unicode: 你好 🌍
HTML escaping: Text with special characters: <>&"' and unicode: 你好 🌍
JSON escaping (Unicode escapes): "Text with special characters: \u003C\u003E\u0026\u0022\u0027 and unicode: \u4F60\u597D \ud83C\udf0D"
URL encoding: Text with special characters: %3C%3E%26%22%27 and unicode: %E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20%F0%9F%8C%8D
Unicode code points: - 你: U+4F60 - 好: U+597D - 🌍: U+1F30D
If you want, I can convert the string into any of these formats (or another encoding you need). Also, if you’d like, I can translate or manipulate the text.
